description: This file is a shell script containing unit tests for a JSON writer utility. It defines several test cases to verify JSON output for various structures, including objects, arrays, nested objects, escaping, and pretty printing. The script uses an external test library and a test tool called 'json-writer'.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specific description.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output with actual output to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs the 'json-writer' tool with specified options and input.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
